title: Optional manual exit price/date override for closing a position
description: DELETE /api/portfolio/positions/{id} hard-locks exit_price to today's live market close and exit_date to today, by an explicit prior design decision (backend-trade-history-table's decisions entry: 'this app already treats current market price as authoritative... not trusting a client-supplied number'). That's reasonable for closing a position you're selling right now, but there's no way to backfill a trade that already fully happened in the past -- importing real trading history, or logging a sale a few days late with its actual fill price. add_position's own docstring explicitly supports this for buys ('Creates a position from manual entry / CSV-import data'); there's no equivalent for a historical sell. This task explicitly revisits that prior decision rather than silently overriding it.

checklist.step: Decide whether to add optional exit_price/exit_date parameters to DELETE /api/portfolio/positions/{id}, weighing the existing 'authoritative market price' rationale against the backfill need -- record a decisions entry that explicitly engages with the prior decision being revisited and why the tradeoff comes out differently now (or doesn't).
Implement the decided behavior: an optional override that defaults to today's existing live-price behavior when not supplied, so no existing caller's behavior changes.
Add validation for the override path (e.g. exit_date not before entry_date, exit_price positive/finite).
Unit tests covering the default (unchanged) path and the override path, including the new validation.
